item.title: 7 Killed as Passenger Bus Falls into 200-Metre Gorge in Uttarakhand’s Almora.
item.description: Deadly Turn on Mountain Road: Bus from Dwarahat to Ramnagar Crashes into Deep Gorge in Almora, Leaving 7 Dead. A tragic bus accident in Uttarakhand’s Almora district on Tuesday morning, December 30, 2025, claimed the lives of seven passengers and left at least 12 others injured when a private bus plunged nearly 200 metres into a deep gorge near Salapani in the Vinayak area. item.title: Dense fog disrupts air traffic; 118 flights cancelled at Delhi airport amid cold wave
item.description: At least 118 flights including 60 arrivals and 58 departures -- were cancelled at Delhi’s Indira Gandhi International Airport, while 16 others were diverted to different cities as dense fog enveloped the national capital and adjoining areas. item.title: FIFA Receives Over 150 Million Ticket Requests For 2026 World Cup
item.description: FIFA has said that it has received more than 150 million ticket requests for the 2026 World Cup to be hosted in Mexico, Canada and the United States of America. Huge ticket requests have set a new World Cup ticketing record with the Random Selection Draw phase only at its halfway point. The Random Selection Draw ticketing phase opened on 11 December this year and will end on 13 January next year.
